keyNotes.title: Key Notes
keyNotes.description: Keep in mind that the Docker container will run in the background. If you need to stop the container, you can run the command `docker stop cis2500` or click the stop button in Docker Desktop. Similarly, you can start the container again with `docker start cis2500` or by clicking the play button.
